name: Hovercraft
requirements: Side-view pixel art facing right, about 30 to 70 px wide (our world: one art pixel is 1/16 unit). Prefer separate wheel sprites so a physics rig can be built, or a clean body plus wheel positions.
notes: Forged: hovercraft_body.png 33x12 (hull + dome + skirt), hovercraft_fan_a.png and _b.png 5x10 (two animation frames for the rear fan, alternate every ~0.05 s). Limits: Fan reads as a narrow cage, not a real duct; fan frames are only a coarse flicker; no shadow or dust.
licence: own work (derivative of CC0 Kenney Pixel Vehicle Pack)

history.note: Searched OGA+itch.io several phrasings. No free CC0 side-view art found. Candidates rejected: top-down speed boats (Sami), kayak with paddler (Spring), Lichee10 top-down vehicles, OGA sled CC-BY
forged from Kenney palette/parts, see FORGE_NOTES
